'''Lubboon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who lived during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. He served the [[Daimanate]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state as the [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of a factory located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Xakrea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]], and fathered the Duros [[Beadle Lubboon]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jarrow Rusher]] visited Lubboon's factory, and he persuaded Lubboon to arrange for him to receive some [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts, in return for Beadle being permitted to join Rusher's [[Rusher's Brigade|mercenary force]].
